name: Bank Marketing
description: The Bank Marketing dataset is related to direct marketing campaigns of a Portuguese banking institution. The marketing campaigns were based on phone calls, and the classification goal is to predict if the client will subscribe to a term deposit based on 16 client, campaign, and economic attributes across 45,211 contacts.
